text:
Alice M.: kicking off v2 staged rollout to eu regions — canary at ~5% now. keeping an eye on p95 and error-rate. DeployBot: deploy job j-4823 started -> eu-west-1a (canary 5%). Bob S.: noticing a small p95 bump on /v2/generate in the canary cluster, ~+6% vs baseline. not huge but consistent across 3 checks. Carol P.: any 5xxs? Bob S.: a few 502-ish spikes, total ~12 in last 15m. mostly tied to longer decode times. DeployBot: canary metrics snapshot: p50 120ms -> 128ms, p95 310ms -> 328ms, errors +0.2%. Dan R.: digging into logs — mobile clients (header `x-client-sdk: mobile-ios` / `mobile-android`) are overrepresented in the spike. routing shows mobile -> v2 canary more than expected. Erica T.: release notes included header changes for v2 (negotiation tweak). could be mobile SDKs not handling the new behavior. Alice M.: hmm. we should avoid impacting mobile users. propose pinning mobile traffic to v1 while letting web traffic continue canary. Carol P.: agree. let's pause rollout and add a header-based route rule: if `x-client-sdk` starts with `mobile` route to /v1. DeployBot: pausing rollout per request from Alice M.. action: hold further canary scale. Bob S.: suggested rollback criteria: if p95 > +15% or error rate >0.5% for 10m -> full rollback of canary to previous model. for now mobile pin should reduce user impact. Dan R.: I can push the route patch to edge config. example patch: ```
curl -X POST https://console.internal.redwood/api/routes/update \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"match":{"headers":{"x-client-sdk":{"prefix":"mobile"}}},"route":"/v1"}'
```
Carol P.: also add a fallback header `x-redwood-pin: v1` from the gateway so clients get explicit behavior. Erica T.: I'll update the v2 release notes with the header caveat and add a quick blurb for mobile SDKs. pinging @mobile-team in case they need to ship a fix. Alice M.: good. timeline: pause now, apply pin (Dan), update release notes (Erica), monitor 30m. if metrics stable we'll resume web canary and keep pin for mobile until SDK patch ships. DeployBot: route update submitted (change-id ch-9072), waiting edge rollout. Bob S.: monitoring dashboards now. will report back at +30m or sooner if thresholds hit. Carol P.: documenting rollback play: 1) pause, 2) route pin, 3) if threshold breached -> rollback canary instances to previous model image id `redwood-model-2.1.4`, notify oncall, escalate to infra. Dan R.: implemented route patch and confirmed edge config propagated to 3/3 eu nodes. Erica T.: release notes updated: "v2: header negotiation changes — mobile SDKs pinned to v1; recommended SDK patch v1.12.3+". Alice M.: thanks all. next check in 30m. :eyes: :thumbsup:
